Since there was no representation from the revision petitioner, notice was issued to her as per order dated 28.01.2026 intimating that the case would be decided in her absence, if there is no representation on the next posting date.

The aforesaid notice is seen returned with the endorsement 'addressee cannot be located'.
2. The defacto complainant in C.C.No.548 of 2003 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Thamarassery, has filed this revision petition aggrieved by the judgment rendered by the said court on 02.03.2006 acquitting the accused in respect of the offence under Section 498A read with Section 34 IPC.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Thamarassery
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The impugned judgment would reveal that the defacto complainant had tendered evidence as PW1 before the Trial Court.

After analysing the entire evidence on record, the Trial Court observed that there was nothing to show that the defacto complainant (PW1) suffered any grievous injury or danger to her life, limb or health.
The Trial Court 2026:KER:19550 also observed that there was no evidence to show that the accused inflicted cruelty to such an extent as to compel her to commit suicide.

Adverting to the evidence on record, the Trial Court also observed that there was nothing to show that the defacto complainant was made to part with any money or property on account of harassment meted out to her by the accused.
It is on the basis of the aforesaid conclusions that the Trial Court held that the offence under Section 498A IPC was not established from the evidence on record.
The analysis of evidence in the above regard by the Trial Court cannot be termed as perverse or against the established principles of law.
There are no grave illegality, irregularity or impropriety warranting interference of this Court in revision upon the aforesaid findings of the Trial Court.
Needless to say, the revision is devoid of merit.
The revision petition is accordingly dismissed.

Sd/-
 G. GIRISH  JUDGE ded/04.03.2026 Valsala vs T.S.Madhu on 4 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67490751/
